title: INTRO TO MECHANCIS OF FLUIDS
description: Liquids and gases in static equilibrium. Continuity equation. Two-dimensional kinematics. Equation of motion. Bernoulli’s equation and applications. Equations of energy and angular momentum. Dimensional analysis. Two-dimensional laminar flow. Pipe flow, laminar, and turbulent. Elements of compressible flow
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E3105 ) ENME E3105 Basic continuum concepts.
